verdict.rationale: Quo's authentication docs say every generated API key grants full API access, so the product documents no scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents. Multiple labeled keys that can be deleted independently is an adjacent capability, not scoping. Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for a SaaS platform with a public API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
